_doc: The zone graph (roadmap phase 0, D-059, D-062): every zone's scene and the connections between zones. Read by ZoneStreamer (core/zones/zone_streamer.gd), which keeps the zones within load_depth connections of the player's zone loaded and frees the rest. A zone's node under Main/Zones is its id in PascalCase (unit_4418 is Unit4418). A connection's door is '<zone>:<node path in that zone>'; ZoneStreamer gives it a ZoneGate, which holds it shut until the zones on both sides are loaded. 'approach': {zone, within}: that zone loads from the other side only while the player is within that many meters of the door (the units: six of them next to the corridor). Swap a unit by pointing its scene somewhere else.
